g.text: OpenArm Multisensor 2.0 | Coded participant 2, trial 1b | Elbow held at 90°
Original figure from recorded, preprocessed signals; 0.5 s sample-weighted means.
0 = relaxed calibration baseline; 1 = calibration contraction signal. Values are not clipped.
Ultrasound and sEMG measure different muscles. Contact force is not an individual-muscle force.
Source: Hallock et al., OpenArm Multisensor 2.0, CC BY 4.0. DOI: 10.1109/TNSRE.2021.3133813
One illustrative trial, not a population law, clinical validation, or subject-specific 3D calibration.
